name: pico2w
comment: Raspberry Pi Pico 2W: RP2350 (Cortex-M33), 4 MB flash, 520 KB SRAM, on-board Wi-Fi/Bluetooth via Infineon CYW43439. Programmed through the bootrom's USB protocol (BOOTSEL mode).
comment_linker: The linker script, the memory map and the startup are the SDK's, reached through the prelude below: an RP2350 image needs the vendor's boot block, its crt0 and its runtime, and a second copy of any of them is a second thing to keep in step with the silicon.

toolchain.comment: the compiler is named so CMake has one before `project()`; the prelude locates the SDK and defines its targets, which carry the architecture flags, the linker script and the startup

flash.comment: the platform's own ELF-to-UF2 converter, which writes to the drive the bootrom publishes; the family ID is the RP2350's ARM Secure one, which the bootrom checks against the part it is running on; hold BOOTSEL while powering the board

uart0_tx.comment: UART0 TX, also accessible via the DEBUG SWD connector
